en: I'm going to find out where I came from.
The Patron will have answers. I know it.
The pain doesn't get any better. I just get better at hiding it.
Forget figuring out my purpose in life, I just wanna know who my left arm belongs to.
Who the hell stitches together dead bodies? At least I hope they were dead bodies. Oh god, what if they weren't dead bodies?
When I think about who made me, I picture some awkward scientist wishing for a son. Knowing my luck, I'm probably a serial killer's walking trophy collection.
People say "meet your maker" like it's some kinda threat, when there's nothing I wouldn't do to meet my own.
I feel like one of my hands belongs to a piccolo player, and the other belonged to a guy who was nicknamed "Johnny Sausage Fingers".
I hate looking into the mirror and staring into a stranger's eyes. Where does he end and I begin?
Someone made me for a reason. I just need to figure out who, and why.
I'm not ready to face my past.
I have some other leads to follow.
I wish I could help, but I need to reattach my arm.
Maybe some secrets are best left buried.
I think I'm gonna spend some time grave-digging.
I'm sorry... my head's not in the right place.
I'm a little busy dealing with existential dread right now.
The Patron can wait. They're not going anywhere, and neither am I.
I have some other leads I need to follow.
Good luck, but you're on your own.
Heard you love a good mystery.
Can you help me with mine?
Don't suppose one of your cases ever had you bumping into some mad genius that lost one of his creations?
You talk very fondly of your creator.
Miss Shelly is a good woman.
Must be nice having someone like that in your life.
After the ritual, I could introduce you to-
No imposition, I insist! People like us need to stick together.
I'm, uh... sorry you don't know who made ya.
Maybe it's a good thing. Not everyone's parents are good people.
You've been talkin' to Pocket, haven't ya?
I'm not trying to be rude, but... how much of you is... original you? Well, not original per se, but-
I see where you're going. No, I haven't had to swap out parts yet. Probably should. My left arm keeps popping off... but it doesn't feel right to discard it when I don't even know who they were.
Keep the cat away from me.
I'm not trying to be an asshole, but if a cat pulls my stitches, it's bad for all of us.
After the ritual, you should stop by The Baroness. Our house tailor is top-notch, should any part of you… pop loose.
That place might be a little fancy for someone like me.
Oh, The Baroness does not discriminate, my friend. I assure you that you will be well taken care of.
I’m a shambling mass of dead bodies, what doesn’t trouble me?
You like working at the hotel?
Catering to rich people is rewarding?
A word of warning, Professor: I tend to find myself in the thick of things.
I think we're gonna get along just fine.
Do they have a medical program?
Where do they get their cadavers?
I'm ready to destroy my body in order to win.
I'm old. Of course I'm hurting.
I'm not talking about your body.
I'll support you the best that I can... but I probably won't be charging in with you.
That's okay, I'm used to working alone.
It used to be literal. Then I retired. Now it's more figurative.
Can I ask you a personal question?
Dream with a capital D, or just in general?
Are they yours? Or do you think they belong to parts of you?
So you find out where you came from, what comes next?
I'm biased, but I think you should consider the OSIC.
I don't think anyone can prepare for something like this.
Are you kidding me? There's a mountain of things you can do to prepare. Drills, research, stretching… and that's not even dipping our toes in divination and fortu-
Forgive me for not being as chatty as some of the other folks around here.
That's fine. I don't mind the silence.
Whole lotta things are bothering me. Nothing you can help with though.
Bring them to me. I'll make them suffer.
You know you don't gotta be a sad bastard all the time, right?
Trust me brother, fixating on your past is no way to build a future.
You're putting your life in danger over real estate?
Hank saved my life. Least I can do is save his business.
You figure out where any of you came from yet?

For a while, I thought my left foot belonged to an accordion player in Milwaukee that was ritually murdered. Turns out he had lost the foot to gangrene, so that was 4 hours on a Greyhound I'm never getting back.
And this other time there was this dad and-
I mean, I am a gargoyle.
Right... but like... you were stone before you were alive?
Do you know who made you?
Who cares? I was a hunk of rock. My life started when I met the Arroyos. Anything before that... doesn't really matter to me.
I'm in chronic pain and my body is stitched together from corpses I can't identify.
So, Victor... I'm not sure what your plans are after the ritual...
Depends on what I glean from the Patron. Could be anything from doing research, to traveling on a bus, to shaking down a mass murderer.
Oh. I don't know. Get a hot dog?
Look at us: A couple of walking corpses ready to stare death in the eye.
You seem fairly cheerful about it.
Why not? It's better than the alternative.
You have no issues with being a grotesque mirror of humanity?
My friend... we were gifted unnatural life. Don't squander it. Travel. Write a book! Find love.
I'm not taking advice from someone wearing a parka in New York.
You have a plan for the battle, my morose friend?
My plans tend to devolve into me throwing my body at my enemies until we all drown in blood.
Ideally, I rise like a macabre phoenix, but... it doesn't always work out.
I'll do whatever I can to keep you in the fight, Victor.
Well, aren't you a ghoulish creature?
You're a shambling mass of flesh. Why wouldn't I be?
My son's a doctor. You should speak to him.
Your condition is only going to worsen without someone to maintain you, and Johann is one of the best in New York. I'll introduce you when this ritual business is concluded.
Why are you being nice to me?
I don't know... but speak of it to no one! I have a reputation to uphold.
You should fight in the Bear Pit.
I'm not into getting mauled by grizzlies.
It's not a literal bear pit. It's a fight club where the winner gets the honor of losing to me.
Yeah, but there's no way I'm going to remember your name. This is a mnemonic.
"Patchwork" isn't a mnemonic, it's just you being shitty.
Here's the plan, Corpse Boy: You draw their fire, and I'll swing in and save the day.
By the time you save the day, they'll be laughing over my dead body.
Exactly! That's when The Lash catches them flat-footed.
What good does that do me?
It gives your sad life meaning, and that should be enough.
I'm sure you're self-conscious about the whole corpse thing, but, I bet if you're in a dimly lit club you'd be a Midwest 8, New York 6.
Whoever stitched you up did a shit job.
You think you could do better?
Of course I could do better.
Didn't realize you were a doctor.
I'm not. I'm someone who actually knows how to sew.
Then fix me up after the ritual.
You walk one of my shows, then sure.
Why not, what else am I gonna do?
I don't hate working with you.
You, uh, ever find any body parts in the sewers?
After the ritual, I don't suppose you'd mind if I took a look to see if I could find any matches?
Good point... yeah, sorry about that.
Just wondering what my life would look like if I had a mole man's arm.
You know, earlier I made a joke about byronic heroes but seeing you here makes it less of a joke and more like I made my highschool diary come to life. [Nervous giggle].
Oh my God, I can't even imagine how many questions you have. "Where did I come from? Who made me? Who am I made of?"
That pretty much covers most of them.
You're a walking mystery novel and I need to know everything.
Hey, I'm... not trying to insert myself into your business. Well I, I guess I kinda am, but I won't be offended if you don't-
[Clears throat] Do you want my help?
I know, you just... you look so sad and... I know what that feels like.
That's very sweet of you. Thank you.
What kinda sick bastard made you?
One dead human's bad enough, now I gotta deal with some kinda cadaver potluck…
You don't have to be an asshole.
You the typa undead that don't have to worry about gettin' sick?
Probably? Might depend on how it's transmitted.
Well, if you want to experiment a little, maybe get hopped up on rabies or somethin' before the fight, I know a guy.
Uh, thanks for the offer but I think I'm good
After the ritual, I'm gonna introduce you to one of my people.
Valerie. She's a good gal, she's just got a wandering heart. Gets it from her mother.
Exactly. So you're gonna be a gentleman, and you're gonna let her down easy, yeah?
[Sigh] I don't have time for this.
They can hurt me, but I'll hurt them right back.
I'll throw my pain back at them.
I can save the pain for later.
I don't fear pain... I weaponize it.
Not looking forward to filling up the pain battery...
This pain's gotta be good for something.
I won't lay down and die.
Sometimes, you have to suffer before you benefit.
In the end, the pain will pay dividends.
I know how to manage pain.
Wish getting a second wind hurt a little less.
I need to do whatever it takes to survive.
The lightning will keep me alive... if it doesn't kill me first.
I can pick up the pace.
They're not killing me anytime soon.
The pain will be worth it!
Need to leave it all out there!
Gonna feel that for a while.
I keep forgetting how much this stings!
I can be tough to be around. I get it.
It's about time I share my pain with others.
I need to be careful not to push it too much.
This'll either win the day or get me killed... too early to tell which one.
There's no price I'm not willing to pay for answers.
I'll take it as long as I can.
I'll tear myself apart if I'm not careful.
Just gotta make sure I don't push myself too hard.
I can't contain it any longer!
This is too much for me to take!
Every one of them will die.
No price is too high to pay.
Ready to stay in the fight.
They can kill me, but I'll pop right back up.
Ready to take whatever they throw at me.
Ready to come back from the dead!
Just gotta remember to pick up all my limbs before rejoining the fight.
They don't have what it takes to kill me.
Let's see 'em try to kill a dead man.
They don't know what resolve really looks like.
I'll hurt, but I'll be back.
They have no idea what I can survive.
It takes more than that to kill me.
I'm not finished with you yet!
Might wanna come back for their arm or something.
You won't get in my way.
You picked the fight, I just finished it.
They didn't have what it takes.
No one's stopping me from getting to the truth.
I didn't wanna have to do this...
I can't let you stop me.
I don't care how much money they had.
You started this fight, I'm just ending it.
I won't stop until I get what I came for!
Now's a good time to give up.
This isn't gonna end well for you!
Why are you picking a fight you can't win?
Don't you get it? I can't die!
You don't have what it takes to stop me.
I didn't come all the way to New York just to lose.
I'll use the shadows to my advantage.
I'll take whatever they throw at me.
I need to improve my abilities.
Can't forget to upgrade my powers.
I need to get to the store.
I should check out the store.
Wonder what they have at the shop?
Wonder what I can get now?
I can pick up something powerful at the store.
I need to think about what to buy.
No point in me saving more souls.
The right item will tip the scales.
That's the last mistake you're gonna make.
I wasn't about to let that happen.
I can see some free souls.
I'll make good use of this.
Hm, let them have the souls.
Doesn't matter, we took the objective.
Look at them trying to save some dignity.
They can have the souls, doesn't matter.
Where the hell did they go?
And they thought they could kill me.
It'll take a lot more than that to stop me.
I'm on my own... I need to be careful.
Don't wanna get jumped out here...
I'm the last one standing... No surprise there.
I'll buy us as much time as I can.
Now's the time to make our move.
They have the Rejuv. They'll be coming for us soon.
I'm ready to complete the ritual!
Let's put them outta their misery.
And now, we complete the ritual!
Can't let my team have all the fun.
Maybe now I can find peace.
We did what we had to do.
No price was too high to pay for victory.
Let's see 'em try to kill a dead man.
It's time to find some answers.
Apologies if I'm in a bad mood, my stitches are killing me today.
I'm hurting, but they're about to feel a helluva lot worse.
Take a look at those guys... They don't have a chance in hell.
I'm tired of waiting, let's start the ritual!
I couldn't have done it without you.
Maybe now I can find peace.
We did what we had to do.
No price was too high to pay for victory.
They don't have an answer for Abrams.
I like the way you think, Bebop.
That's, uh... That's a lotta bullets.
We make a good team, Fern.
It's nice not having to work alone.
Thanks for keeping me standing, Kelvin.
He's an asshole, but he knows what he's doing.
Couldn't've done it without you, McGinnis.
I'm buying her a beer later.
Thanks for looking after me, McGinnis.
Now there's a man who understands pain.
It's like watching a vengeful god.
Look at that lightning... It's beautiful.
They don't have what it takes to kill Shiv.
Glad she's with us and not them.
How the hell'd she do that?!
Took a lot to stop him.
For the love of God, Abrams, just die.
Will someone help me kill Abrams?
I need help with the detective.
Bebop's going back to the scrap pile.
I'm not afraid of you, Bebop.
At least you have a creator you're proud of, Bebop.
Go back to Ms. Shelly while you can, Bebop.
You made for an easy target, Bebop.
Think that guy could chew my arm off if I let him.
Think I'd rather deal with Lash.
I'm not letting that cat pull out my stitches.
Sorry, Ava. Your owner is kind of an asshole.
Thought she was supposed to be a scary assassin?
What the hell was that thing?
If that was a normal Doorman, I have two matching hands.
He won't be stalking us anymore.
I won't let you slaughter my friends.
Go home to your wife, Dynamo.
The old man fought like hell.
If I didn't stop him, who knows how much damage he would have done.
You can't kill a dead man, Haze.
Thought the OSIC would be more of a problem.
I don't want trouble, Haze. Just leave me alone.
You can't hide from me, Haze.
You're not getting away that easy, Haze.
She won't be lassoing us for a while.
Holliday's making a break for it.
Just go back to the bar, man.
It's pointless fighting me, Infernus, just go home.
Can't let you do that, Fern.
That bartender can't catch a break.
You got in my way, Ivy.
I'm not like anything you've faced before, Ivy.
No point in chasing her down now.
So much for the dead sticking together.
The cold's not a problem for me, Kelvin.
Quit making this harder on yourself, Kelvin.
Should've tried running away sooner, Kelvin.
I'm not afraid of you or Oathkeeper, Geist.
I'm not afraid of you, Lady Geist.
Don't get too close to Geist.
Don't let Geist swap your health!
You're not going to intimidate me, Lash.
Glad I'm done dealing with him.
He was in over his head.
At least she had the dignity to die with her creations.
I'm sick of dealing with these damn turrets.
How many of these damn things does she have?
Maybe Mina will have a little more humility.
Someone had to shut her up.
I've been to Wyoming. You don't want it.
I can't let you win, Mirage.
I couldn't let him stop me.
For a second, I was worried that I couldn't outlast him.
The mole is scary, but not as scary as me.
Think I might have popped a seam.
Get this mole off of me!
All she could do was delay the inevitable.
Go back to the library, kid.
She won't be shielding anyone for a while.
Well, at least you'll have books to read in the hospital.
Paradox is out of the way.
I'm not here for your games, Paradox.
That the best you got, Paradox?!
You picked the wrong fight, lady.
Should've hid in that case, Pocket.
Any other day, I would have wished them luck.
I don't even wanna know what they got in that case.
It's cute you thought electricity was enough to kill me.
He was too smart for his own good.
What was he gonna do anyway? Make me leak embalming fluid?
You're not turning me into a pincushion, Shiv.
He thought he could outlast me.
He's going to come back, and he's going to be pissed.
Can we just kill Shiv already?
Guess they didn't copy my power.
That's for trying to turn me into a rabbit.
He'll be back, I know it.
You should have picked better friends, Vindicta.
Thought you were safe up there?
Knocked her right outta the sky.
He had no idea what he was getting into, did he?
The Cube was never going to be enough.
This isn't the place for tourists.
Did any goo get inside me?
She and Lash deserve each other.
Least I won't have to deal with Warden for a while.
He didn't go down without a fight.
Gotta be ready for him to come back.
This is going to be a long day, isn't it?
Fight me again, and the same thing will happen, Wraith.
Lucky I didn't lose a limb.
I really should learn how to speak Japanese.
That fight could have gone real bad for me.
That woman's gonna come looking for revenge.
He looks more brooding than normal.
I put him out of his misery.
Don't try getting back up, Victor.
You ain't standin' in my way, Victor!
I'm sorry for your pain, Victor.
Get back up! I dare you!
Cry about your pain some more, Victor!
We all got pain, Victor. What do you want? A hot water bottle and a blankie?
So I kill the bastard, then he gets to pop back up with full health and just off me?! Heh, cool.
That guy really needs to loosen up.
That had to be the most uptight corpse I've ever seen.
Jesus, Victor... would it kill you to smile?
That guy was tough to bring down.
Return to obscurity, Victor, it's where you belong!
You’ve looked so hard for answers, Victor, yet they still elude you... It must be exhausting. Take a moment to rest. The mysteries of your past will be there tomorrow.
You weren’t made for great purpose, you were made on a whim, to satisfy some scientist’s hubris.
Ain't no fun when you're just putting someone outta their misery.
He'll sew himself up and be back.
Come back any time, Victor. I'll be ready.
I mean, you’re a pile of dead bodies, of course the necromancer was going to win.
You should've came to me for help, Victor.
Too bad. He was kinda cool.
At least I stopped his pain...
The dead can be so pushy sometimes.
I won't let you get in my way, Victor!
Corpses are such a pain in the ass to kill.
I wish you luck in your search, but you are not winning today.
I'm not getting stopped by a dead man!
It's not homicide when they're already dead.
New York brings out all the crazies...
Victor, just get outta my way and file a missing person's report on your arm or something!
That guy needs to lighten up.
All things considered... He's a pretty good lookin' corpse!
He'll be back sooner than I'd like.
That guy's having a rough day.
I'll help you after the ritual, Victor, but for now, I have to stop you.
I bet I could get Carlos to lend you a shirt.
I was hoping us corpses could stick together.
I wish you good luck on your search, my friend, but... I can't let you win.
Sadly, my search for the truth has to trump your own.
If you wanted to be "glass half-full"... At least he's not in pain.
His is a life hardly worth stealing.
And you thought you were in pain before, Victor.
By the time I'm through with him, he's gonna have to find himself a new face.
Come on, Victor, get up so I can do that again.
He'll model for me one day.
He looked so sad... Oh well, who cares?
I hate killing a man who can pull off leather pants.
So, now that you know you're gonna lose, do you think your name's ironic or just tragic?
One day, you will find what you seek, Victor.
I'm sorry that your answers will not be found today.
Good luck in your search, Victor.
Alas, some mysteries will never get solved, Victor.
Victor, you have the soul of a poet... it's a shame you fought with the competence of one as well.
Good luck in your search, Victor, but success eludes you today.
Any other day, and we would've been glad to help you.
He was in so much pain!
I wish I could help him...
I-I didn't want to fight you, Victor.
Smile more, Victor. Life is more fun that way.
Yer not going to win, Victor!
You're never going to find answers on your own, Victor.
He's probably okay with being dead.
When is it my turn to hold the lightning rod?
You don't know a thing about real suffering, Victor!
I put the cadaver man down!
We all got problems, Victor, yours aren't special.
You aren't as tough as you thought, dead man.
Victor, quit moping around and try to live a life!
The answers you're looking for are going to elude you today, Victor.
I took down the walking cadaver.
The pain doesn't go away, Victor.
I wish you luck on finding answers another day, Victor.
Victor, this is not your day.
I took down the cadaver man.
You're a shambling mass of flesh, boo-hoo.
That guy thinks he's the only ones with problems here.
As far as I'm concerned, I did that sad bastard a favour!

You're in pain, Victor, more than you ever let on. More than any could ever know! But it need not be the case. Complete the ritual, and let the Hidden King... be a balm to soothe you.
You were made for a purpose, Victor, and the Hidden King can show it to you once you complete the ritual!
Death has no hold on you, Victor. Kill them all!
No one can stand against Victor!

It's nice to have a regular who can't die on me.
You're like Marley with a staple gun, Victor.
C'mon Victor, cheer up! Have some eggnog and live a little!
Isn't it a little cold not to wear a shirt?
You have some of the most fascinating tattoos!
Whoever made you really knew what they were doing.
You, sir, have the torso of an Italian underwear model--but the heart of a poet.
So I don't know if you can see it but I think one of your stitches may be coming loose in the back.
I know you don't have a fear of death but I do, so if you could be careful I would be eternally grateful.
I'll make them pay for that.
You wanted to face me? Well, here I am!
They're gonna find out real fast who they're dealing with.
We might have to rethink things.
This isn't exactly how I'd hoped things would be going.
There's still time to win this.
We need to rally before it's too late.
I was never going to be stopped.
I did what I had to do.
It's time for the Patrons to live up to their end of the bargain.
I couldn't have done this without you.
I'm ready to face my past.
The truth is still out there... I know it.
I'll pick myself up and try again.
It won't end this way next time.
Just gonna have to put myself back together and try again.
They won't be lucky next time.
